nodes.statement: The PyTorch surrogate is the third interchangeable engine at the interface: it constructs over the same 91-state sepsis spec and completes a full 48 h / 576-step rollout live (0.198 s, finite but out of physical range), so swapping to it is one node-address change like swapping BioGears for exact Tellurium — interchangeability of interface, with speed deferred to study 04 and accuracy to study 05 (the proposed validator).

nodes.label: The 4+ order-of-magnitude compute spread is a real, matched-spec measurement ...
nodes.statement: The 4+ order-of-magnitude compute spread is a real, matched-spec measurement — but it is a statement about cost alone: the surrogate's ~40,000x full-run and ~13,000x per-step speedups become usable only once the fidelity gate is met, so the number that decides whether the surrogate is a drop-in replacement lives in study 05, not here.

nodes.label: The hemodynamic divergence is not transcription noise but two internally-cons...
nodes.statement: The hemodynamic divergence is not transcription noise but two internally-consistent, opposite shock trajectories: the engine reaches MAP<65 by a hypodynamic low-output route (69.3 h) and the extraction by a hyperdynamic vasodilatory route (54.1 h). The ~15 h timing gap — earlier despite the extraction lagging ~11 h on systolic pressure — together with the engine's continuous fluctuation versus the extraction's near-flat profile, is the signature of the vasomotor, fluid, and metabolic subsystems the extraction omits, not of a faithfulness failure in the shared spec.
